### Borea v0.5.0-dev.2: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.5.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.4.1.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Game bounds: a mod or pack whose `game_max` is older than your game is now Incompatible and cannot be installed. Borea no longer shows Untested. Check that the chips, the pack page and the install plan say this clearly.
- Discover: sort the Mods and Modpacks tabs by "Recently listed". The newest listings should come first.
- Scrolling: scroll Discover, a long mod page, the Library and the listing editor with the mouse wheel, one notch at a time and fast. Each notch should continue the glide and not start it again.
- Instances: the Mods, Dependencies, Vehicles, Saves and Backups lists of an instance now line up like a table. Check them in a narrow window, while a mod updates and while a confirmation is open.
- Windows: if you installed KSA with the new Ahwoo client, Borea should offer its game folder.
- Mod authors: the listing editor has a "Tag prefix" field under Releases, and it now checks a listing with the same rules and words as the index.

#### New since v0.5.0-dev.1

- A `game_max` now blocks: content above it is Incompatible, and a dependency falls back to an older release that fits. Content without a `game_max` stays Compatible. The CLI says incompatible instead of untested.
- Discover can sort by "Recently listed".
- Smooth scrolling keeps its speed from notch to notch, and the wheel over a field that cannot scroll moves the page.
- The lists of an instance line up like a table.
- The Versions tab of a mod page shows the downloads of each release.
- On Windows, Borea finds KSA when the Ahwoo client installed it.
- KSA 2026.10.13.5602 is a verified build.
- The .NET security update of v0.4.1 is in this build too.
- Mod authors: the listing editor reads and keeps `tag_prefix`, checks the folder in your release zip before the pull request, reads your listed images again and suggests a commit address for an image on a branch, and explains a refused value in words, as the index does.
- Stewards: comment on, close and reopen a report from the Reports tab.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.5.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
